{
  "name": "focus-timer",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "A focus timer in the band above the prompt: /focus-timer starts a block, the band counts it down with pause, skip and stop buttons, a toast marks each switch, and every fourth break is a long one.",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "author": {
    "name": "Tadata"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "focus",
    "pomodoro",
    "timer",
    "band",
    "productivity"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "focus_minutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Focus block",
      "description": "Minutes in a focus block.",
      "default": 50,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 180
    },
    "break_minutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Break",
      "description": "Minutes in a break.",
      "default": 10,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 60
    },
    "long_break_minutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Long break",
      "description": "Minutes in the break after every fourth focus block.",
      "default": 25,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 120
    }
  }
}
